set.body:
Scheduling lane: closed. Governing plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19: Acceptance consolidated into canonical clock integration bd-01M2WTGF981AY7RCN8QC42JSPT. This closure removes duplicate scheduling, not implementation work.

Historical finding and scope retained below; current acceptance ownership above governs.

Atlas carries the SourceDerivationReceipt of the ClockRepair that placed each row, so every mapped row can cite the derivation that put it on the playback axis.

This feeds the provenance the recall-map output schema asks for (bd-01M2TADC4VKSDZ2S9SXETH2MYM: "score provenance including the ... receipt"), and the CODE RED terminal court's "exact interval and receipt links resolve" and its "foreign receipt" mutation (bd-01M1CQ2H7VPSKRT02M5H7HN1K6).

Since b464ceaf the receipt quotes the record's own crosswalk id and formula, and the formula is checked against the implementation. Tests: every row's receipt is the repair for its own run; a row cannot carry the other run's receipt.
set.title: C1: Atlas carries each row's ClockRepair receipt, so a mapped row cites the derivation that placed it
